svg.aria-label: Fig 1. Arthai Health planned flow, drawn as nine stations on one bench. 1 claim builder and scrubber, 2 payer and clearinghouse mock, 3 remit posting, 4 triage with the CCI confidence gate, 5 review console and audit, 6 appeal writer, 7 voice agent, 8 AR follow-up, 9 eval and feedback loop. Green track: the gate is sure and the claim goes to the appeal writer. Red track: the gate is not sure and a human reviews the claim. Blue dotted track: reviewer edits feed the eval loop and recalibrate the gate. Every station is planned; none is built.

svg.text: Synthetic data only. Every station is planned. None is built yet.
1 Claim builder and scrubber: builds the 837, runs NCCI and MUE edits
2 Payer and clearinghouse mock: our own fake insurer, 835 and 277 out
3 Remit posting: reads the 835, finds each denied line
4 Triage + CCI gate: LAYA scores, conformal set decides the path
5 Review console + audit: human queue, approvals, audit trail
6 Appeal writer: Muse drafts, each statement cites a source
7 Voice agent: browser call to the mock insurer rep
8 AR follow-up: ranks open claims for the next action
9 Eval and feedback loop: reviewer edits become eval cases
Tracks: green = gate is sure. red = not sure, to a human. blue = feedback.
